name: Launch Ready
description: Pre-launch website QA: deterministic rule-based scans, readiness score, and blockers for agents. Tools: scan_site, get_report, list_blockers, list_findings, get_finding, list_projects, and create_share_link (Agency plan only). Every request requires a Launch Ready workspace API key (lr_live_…) sent as Authorization: Bearer, created in Settings → API keys and available on every plan, including the $0 Free plan; this entry does not configure that key.
